title: ACME beats third-quarter estimates as rocket sales climb
content:
ACME Rockets reported third-quarter revenue of 4.2 billion dollars on Tuesday, ahead of analyst forecasts, as demand for its reusable launch vehicles kept growing.

Chief executive Wile Coyote said the order book now covers 41 launches through 2028, and that the company expects to add a second assembly line next spring.

Shares of the company rose in early trading. Analysts at the fictional Roadrunner Research raised their price target.

title: ACME shares slide after guidance cut
content:
Shares of ACME Rockets fell sharply after the company cut its full-year guidance, citing a delay at its main supplier. The stock is down 12 percent this week.

title: Rocket makers lobby for a longer launch window
content:
Industry groups asked regulators on Monday to extend the launch licensing window from 30 to 60 days. The proposal is opposed by two environmental groups.
